case_title: JAMES W BYNUM VS. SALEM MEDIA GROUP

docket_entries.description: THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BYNUM, JAMES W IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SALEM MEDIA GROUP DBA XULON PRESS DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF NOTHING. DEFENDANT HAD PREVIOUSLY PROVIDED PLAINTIFF A FULL REFUND AND FULL PAYMENT ON ALL BOOK ROYALTIES. PLAINTIFF DID NOT PROVE ANY OTHER CONTRACT DAMAGES.
